# synology_group (Resource)

A local DSM group. Import by group name. Built-in groups can be imported but never deleted.

## Adopt existing settings

1. Add the import block below with your resource address and the ID of the existing DSM object.
2. Set your arguments to the values DSM currently reports. The sample configuration shows the shape and uses example values.
3. Run `terraform plan`. For one import, apply only when it reports `1 to import, 0 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy`.

```terraform
import {
  to = synology_group.team
  id = "team"
}
```

## Example configuration

```terraform
resource "synology_group" "team" {
  name                = "team"
  description         = "Archive readers"
  deletion_protection = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Local group name and import identifier.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Reject deletion using the last applied value. Disable in a separate apply before intentionally deleting a custom group.
- `description` (String) Group description. An empty value clears it.

### Read-Only

- `gid` (Number) Numeric DSM group identifier.
